task.name: Strike_bar
task.when: During Strike after the final bar and cheese service closes

step.action: Have the Bar Lead confirm that service is closed and identify the wine to pack.
Pack the identified wine in its transport container.
Move all cooler meltwater into 🔧 Gray-Water_IBC.
Remove the cooler, service supplies, and trash bins from the bar footprint.
Dismantle the bar in the reverse sequence printed in 📦 Build_Book.
Put every bar fastener and small part in its assigned 📦 Build_Hardware_Bins bin.
Pack each clean, dry bar component in the transport group shown in 📦 Build_Book.

passWhen.criterion: Wine and bar supplies are packed in their assigned transport containers.
No cooler water reached the playa.
Every bar component and hardware piece is clean, dry, accounted for, and packed.
The former bar footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
